judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation, leaving its own `.lore/dod.md` tracking file in the diff with two of four facets unchecked. While static schema compilation at registration time and basic input rejection in `ToolRegistry.execute` work, function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` definitions are compiled only once at `register` time rather than resolved per call with `WeakMap` caching, breaking dynamic schemas. Most required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (extra-property passthrough, dynamic schema updates, static compilation count, and unknown tool throw) and the test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing, with four tests placed in an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file instead. Finally, the candidate omits the one-line JSDoc comment on `execute`, fails to update `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`, and leaves `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md` incomplete.
